patch_description:
This implementation replaces the fixed triangular-hull search with a rotationally structured polygonal hull and an active-constraint annealing strategy. It keeps a regular outer ring fixed, which makes the convex hull area constant and removes expensive dynamic hull calculations, while allowing the remaining points to occupy a substantially less restrictive region than a reference triangle.

The search uses several deterministic hull layouts (primarily 7- and 8-sided outer rings), structured ring initializations, lower-tail scoring over the smallest triangle determinants, active-triple-guided mutations, annealed acceptance, and a final coordinate polishing stage. Interior points are projected into the incircle of the fixed polygon, guaranteeing that the outer ring remains the convex hull throughout optimization.
